deferred_named_owners.insertion_contract: A manager module registered through PMManagerKit.register(id, builder) returning the same ManagerSpec shape; Settings hosts it at #/m/manager-project-sync and links it from Server & hosts. Settings never implements the sync state machine.
deferred_named_owners.why_deferred: PACKET/07 forbids concept agents from modelling Project Sync state machines.

deferred_named_owners.family: Browser Runtime / Browser Program / Expert Browser
deferred_named_owners.insertion_contract: Registers as manager-browser with sections for workspaces, programs and the human-only AuthBrowser session; Settings shows profile and permission rows only, never DOM or capture surfaces.
deferred_named_owners.why_deferred: PACKET/07 marks the AuthBrowser session human-only and inspection-free; a Settings concept cannot demonstrate it honestly.

deferred_named_owners.insertion_contract: One policy manager registered as manager-performance; Settings surfaces the single governor policy and its observed phases, and must not add a second concurrency control anywhere else.
deferred_named_owners.why_deferred: PACKET/SOURCE_AND_PRECEDENCE_MAP requires exactly one governor policy owner; four concepts inventing editors would create four.

deferred_named_owners.insertion_contract: Provider installation rows already carry updateAttempt evidence; the release owner registers manager-updates and Settings links installation rows to it rather than duplicating rollback policy.
deferred_named_owners.why_deferred: Update/repair/rollback policy is highest-precedence canon in PROVIDER_CLI_FINAL_ADJUDICATION.md.
